[Intro]
[G]

[Verse 1]
[G]How am I supposed to raise you
when
[C]I'm so afraid
Of
[G]all that I can pass down
It
[Bm]won't be just my name
[C]I've tried so hard to i-
magine our place The
[G]tears streaming down from my
face My
[C]father meant nothing to me
But I
[D]hope I mean something to you

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight
[D]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight

[Break 1]
[G]

[Verse 2]
[G]How am I supposed to move on
when
[C]I'm so afraid
Of the
[G]loneliness that I feel
when the
[Bm]sun sets on your grave
I
[C]guess the best thing I can
do with my time is
[G]love every minute of li-
fe When the
[C]fact is I would rather curl
up and die I
[D]can't breathe if you're not ali-
ve

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight
[D]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight
[C]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight
[D]Grab my hand, hold it tight,
let the water take us tonight

[Chorus]
[G]
How do I forget you
[D]If
there is light, I hope it finds you
[Em]How can I forget you How can I for-
get you If
[D]there is light, I hope it finds you If
there is light, I hope it finds you
[G]My heart will break over
spilling your blood I'm
[D]lonely as death and I
want to give up Cause
[Em]I can't keep breathing this
pain in my lungs
[D]I'll never forget our love
I'll never forget our love

[Post-Chorus]
[C]If there is light, I hope it finds you
[D]If there is love, I hope it finds you
[Em]Let the good deep inside you
[D]Let your love be the thing that de-
fines you

[Break 2]
[G]If there is light it'll find you,
don't be afraid

[Solo]
[C]
[D]
[Em]
[G]
[C]
[D]
[Em]
[D]

who we would die for [D]

not dying alone We've [D]got to

If there is light it'll find you,
don't be afraid
